text:
QUOTE: The deny list is enforced later, inside `ServerManager::execute`, not in the approval step. ... `is_denied` uses the same matcher, but only in `ServerManager::execute` ... A match returns an error result without running the tool, and it is enforced regardless of allow or auto-approve.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the deny list is enforced in `ServerManager::execute`, but it also describes a chain of other blocking checks: the anti-spiral hard block, schema, MCP authorization, tier, the duplicate-call check, and approval denial when no callback is set. It never concludes that deny is the only list that blocks execution, and it contradicts that by saying the allow list gates approval.
